data.title: 诀 · 疗伤温泉氤氲青瓷松袍
data.action: 坐于温泉木廊浴袍领口微敞肩线滑落
data.lighting: 温暖昏黄木灯笼光穿透袅袅汤雾
data.description: 泡完药汤后，汤屋里弥漫着草药与热汽的温润气息。李织烟松松系着青瓷色真丝浴袍坐在温热木沿上，敞开的领口顺着一侧肩头轻滑下来，白皙肌肤泛着沐浴后的淡粉水光。她收起平日作为队长的冷肃防备，眼神微润地望着走近的你。
data.promptProse: Sitting on the warm cypress ledge of a steam-filled private bathhouse, Arcane wears a loose celadon silk bathrobe slipping off one shoulder, her flushed damp skin glowing softly in dim lantern light as she watches the viewer.
data.animaCaption: She sits on the steamy wooden bathhouse ledge with her celadon silk robe slipping off one shoulder, gazing warmly at the viewer.
